# Kettlebell Academy of New Zealand

> > StrongFirst-certified kettlebell training and fitness minimalism coaching by Kat Tabakova in Palmerston North, New Zealand.

The academy offers online classes, courses, and evidence-based kettlebell instruction rooted in Russian hardstyle methods from Pavel Tsatsouline, Jeff Martone, and Steve Cotter. Kat Tabakova (SFG L2, IKSFA) teaches a philosophy of fitness minimalism emphasizing essential movements over complex programming.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell training
- Fitness minimalism
- StrongFirst methodology
- Pavel Tsatsouline
- Hardstyle technique
- Girevoy Sport
- IKSFA certification
- Kettlebell swings
- Strength training fundamentals
- Bodybuilding vs kettlebells
- Complementary exercises
- Winter outdoor training
- Mindfulness in training
- Jeff Martone
- Steve Cotter

## About & Services

- [Kettlebell Academy of New Zealand](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com): Homepage: fitness minimalism, kettlebell coaching, StrongFirst certified
- [About Kat](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/about-kat): Kat Tabakova bio: StrongFirst SFG L2, IKSFA instructor, Palmerston North
- [Online Kettlebell Classes](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/live-training-online-offline): Live online classes via fitness app, monthly memberships from US$20
- [Online Courses](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/online-courses): Online courses page for kettlebell training and fitness education

## Training Philosophy & Essential Exercises

- [The Philosophy of Fitness Minimalism](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/2019/04/02/the-philosophy-of-fitness-minimalism): Core philosophy: maturity, stoicism, keystone habits, delayed gratification
- [10 Essential Exercises for Optimal Fitness](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/2020/05/05/top-10-golden-exercises): Fitness minimalism: top 10 exercises including swings, carries, climbing
- [Exercises in addition to kettlebell training](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/2023/07/26/exercises-in-addition-to-kettlebell-training): Q&A on complementary exercises: walking 8k steps, calisthenics basics

## Kettlebells vs Other Training Methods

- [What Kettlebellers Can Learn from Bodybuilders and Old School Russians](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/2021/08/03/what-kettlebellers-can-learn-from-bodybuilders-and-old-school-russians): Hardstyle vs bodybuilding: rep ranges, hypertrophy, joint health
- [Kettlebells vs Bodybuilding](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/2021/07/05/kettlebells-vs-bodybuilding): Form vs function: maintaining bodybuilding muscle with kettlebells

## Technique & Training Tips

- [Can I turn out my toes in kettlebell swing?](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/2021/09/18/can-i-turn-out-my-toes-in-kettlebell-swing): Technical Q&A: toe turnout in swings vs squats, hip hinge mechanics
- [How to Kettlebell Train Outside in the Winter](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/2021/05/29/how-to-kettlebell-train-outside-in-the-winter): Winter outdoor training tips: warm-up routines, cold weather benefits
- [Mindfulness Doesn't Rock – it SWINGS.](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/2018/09/11/mindfulness-doesnt-rock-it-swings): Kettlebell sport competition reflection: mindfulness, mental focus, NZGSA

## Resources & Recommended Reading

- [Recommended Reading](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/bookworm-faves): Curated kettlebell book recommendations from Pavel, Martone, Cotter

## Optional

- [The Cost of Truth](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/2017/08/20/the-cost-of-truth): Personal philosophy: life trade-offs, blog origins, growth through truth

- [The Cost of Not Being a Kid](https://katskettlebelldojo.wordpress.com/2017/08/27/the-cost-of-not-being-a-kid): Inner child work: emotional development, depression recovery, parenting
